name: Aaron Levie
role: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
summary:
What gets missed with AI productivity gains is that by and large, most roles will continue to be as sophisticated as the tools allow.
This is why also thinking through “today’s jobs will be replaced with AI” is a fallacy. Everyone thinks the market is static, but it’s not.
As
hot take :) The biggest and most productive people in the AI era are the folks who are already good at their jobs. AI as a multiplier, not an equalizer/democratizer

name: 今日总结
summary: 从今天追到的这些 builder 动态看，行业注意力正在变得更务实。模型相关讨论没有停在跑分，而是开始外溢成具体产品路线和生态站位，支付、集成、部署和浏览器运行时这些底层摩擦，正在重新决定交付速度，开发动作继续向 AI 原生迁移，真正稀缺的越来越是任务拆解和系统组织能力。现在真正拉开差距的，越来越不是会不会做，而是能不能持续交付。
